_about: Hand-verified ground truth for the four sample certificates.
Read off the scans by eye, not by OCR. This is the yardstick: run
tools/check_accuracy.py against a real extraction CSV to get a
field-by-field accuracy score before quoting a client an accuracy %.
Add a new entry here every time a scan reveals a new layout quirk.

_quirks: A second unlabelled number (7866) sits between the Reg. Folio No.
and the Certificate No. It is a ledger/transfer number, NOT a folio.
Do not let it land in folio_no or registered_folio_no.
Large ENDORSED stamp across the holder block -> remarks.
Paid up Rs 5 on application out of Rs 10 face value: face value is
Face value (50) genuinely EQUALS the share count (50). Any rule that
flags fv == no_of_shares outright produces a false positive here.
10% Convertible Cumulative Redeemable Preference: share_type must not
come out as Equity.
Paid-up value stands reduced to Rs 30 and converts into 2 equity
shares of Rs 10 -> belongs in remarks, not in face_value_per_share.
Four stray numbers above the body text (0066395, 00001/00001,
064449, 05861000474) must not be mistaken for the folio.
Holder address block (MAHALLKSHMI OIL MILLS, INDORE) sits directly
under the name: address must not be appended to share_holder_name.
Heavy background guilloche pattern - the hardest of the four to read.
Same unlabelled second number pattern as Kabra (10984).
Ampersand in the company name must survive as '&'.
Date reads '1ST DAY OF DECEMBER 1994 AT INDORE' - the trailing place
name must not break the date parse.
